Subject: Pricing path & sign-off — post-demo recap

Hi Emma — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on budget/decision process: 

Summary from our side:
- Expected production token volume (your estimate): you mentioned growth from an initial pilot to steady-state. Need your confirmation on the monthly range.
- Target unit economics: we discussed target $/1M tokens that would make this work for AveryTech.
- Decision stakeholders: we need to confirm the economic buyer and finance approver for an official quote and PO timeline.

Requests / asks: 
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token band (pilot -> steady state)? A quick range like 5–20M / 20–50M / 50–100M is fine.
2) Target price per 1M tokens you're modeling (ballpark). If you have a target blended $/1M that the CFO would accept, that helps us configure a proposal.
3) Who will sign on the economics (name and role)? We heard Luke might be the budget owner and Priya the finance approver — can you confirm?
4) Timeline: what date would you need a formal quote and projected start-of-billing?

What we'll do after we get those answers: Marissa (cc'd) will prepare a 1-page pricing band (pdf) with an example cost model and options for committed vs. burst capacity. Diego (cc'd) will be ready for a technical follow-up if you want to walk the finance team through throughput/caching assumptions.

I attached a draft price-band template and the demo notes we took. If it's helpful, propose a 30-minute touch with Luke & Priya next week — we can bring a concise cost model and a procurement checklist.

Thanks — Priyom

Priyom — thanks for the clear recap and for taking notes. Answers inline below: 

1) Monthly token band (pilot -> steady state):
- Pilot (first 2 months): ~7–12M tokens/month
- Early scale (months 3–6): ~25–40M tokens/month
- Steady state (12+ months): we expect 60–85M tokens/month depending on feature uptake

2) Target price per 1M tokens: Our CFO is modeling to a target blended cost of ~$220–$280 / 1M tokens for FY27; lower would be preferred but that's the current planning band.

3) Decision stakeholders: 
- Budget owner: Luke Harper, VP Product (he controls the product org budget and has been driving this initiative).
- Finance approver: Priya Singh, Director of Finance (she will need the formal numbers and procurement path).
I've cc'd both so you have them in-thread.

4) Timeline: We need a formal quote by July 20 to include in our budgeting conversation on July 28. Ideally a 1-page summary + a short walk-through for finance.

Also: Priya — quick note for you: are there standard requirements we should be aware of (PO terms, SOC 2 evidence, or any firewall/VPC needs) for a procurement-ready quote?

Happy to jump on the call if that helps.

Best,
Emma
Director of Product Strategy
AveryTech

Emma / Luke / Priya — great to be in touch, and thanks for the clear numbers. I'll take point on producing the 1-page formal pricing band and a short cost model that maps to the bands you shared. Quick note on what we'll include: 

- Pricing band PDF (attached): committed tier pricing for three bands (0–20M, 20–60M, 60–100M) with sample monthly invoices at $/1M levels spanning $180–$320 so you can see delta to your $220–$280 target.
- Example committed vs. on-demand mix and the projected blended unit cost for each scenario.
- A procurement checklist (PO flow, SOC 2 attestation link, standard terms, suggested SLA) and a short note about our private/dedicated options if you need data isolation.

Priya: for procurement nuance — our standard commercial terms and SOC 2 report link are in the procurement checklist. If you need an NDA or specific vendor forms completed, tell me and we'll prioritize. Diego can join the finance call to explain how usage patterns (prefix caching and batching) affect the effective $/1M.

Proposed next steps (please reply with availability): 
- Deliver 1-pager by EOD Jul 16 so you have two business days to review before the 20th deadline.
- 30-minute finance walk-through with Priya and Luke: optional slots on Jul 17 at 10:00am PT or Jul 19 at 2:00pm PT.

If that works, I'll mark the HubSpot deal (AVY-1243) with the deliverable and open a short DocuSign estimate once you confirm the band.

Thanks,
Marissa
